recipe.name: Node.js app
evidence: Scripts: build, build:watch, dev, lint, lint:fix, test, prepublishOnly
The start command is the official dev preview (n8n-node dev): it boots a real n8n with this package linked on port 5678, readiness at /healthz/readiness.

That preview installs a second complete n8n under ~/.n8n-node-cli, so on a small host run the runtime boot as: MN_API_KEY=... bash test/manual/docker-load-verify.sh (a throwaway n8n in Docker, port 5688, same readiness path), or record build+test with: hermes verify --json --skip-start.
Live API checks live in test/live-api.test.mjs and need MN_API_KEY.
